posts.title: booksXRS v1.0.0 Released
posts.excerpt: A new openglix app build is now available for direct APK download, with QR scanning and release notes.
posts.author: openglix Team
content: booksXRS v1.0.0 is now listed on openglix. You can download it from the APK Downloads page or scan its QR code with your phone.
This is the first public build for booksXRS. The listing includes version information, file size, and changelog details.
To add more information later, edit data/apps.json and data/updates.json. No rebuild step is required.

posts.title: booksXR v1.1.1 Released
posts.excerpt: Full bilingual support, reminder fixes, custom categories, and PDF export with category breakdown.
posts.author: openglix Team
content: booksXR v1.1.1 is now available. This release focuses on reliability, bilingual support, and cleaner reports.
Highlights include full English and Nepali support, reminder timing fixes, custom categories, and PDF export with category breakdown.
The update also fixes the issue where a question mark appeared instead of a minus sign, and improves the balance display for large numbers.
Download the new APK from the APK Downloads page and install it over your existing version. Your app data is normally preserved.

posts.title: How to Install an APK Safely on Android
posts.excerpt: A simple guide to downloading, verifying, and installing APK files outside the Play Store.
posts.author: openglix Team
content: Android allows you to install apps from APK files, but you should only install APKs from sources you trust.
Download the APK from openglix and open it from your notification bar or Files app. Android may ask you to allow installation from unknown sources for your browser.
If Google Play Protect shows a warning, read it carefully. Only continue if you trust the source and the file you downloaded.
After installation, open the app and check that the version matches the release notes on this site.

posts.title: openglix Website Launched
posts.excerpt: openglix now has an official home for APK downloads, release notes, and guides.
posts.author: openglix Team
content: openglix now has an official website. You can download apps directly, scan QR codes, and read the latest updates.
The site is static and data-driven. Apps and posts are managed from JSON files, so publishing a new release is quick.

posts.title: Security Update
posts.excerpt: Added fingerprint unlock and auto-lock features to keep financial data safer.
posts.author: openglix Team
content: A security update added fingerprint unlock and auto-lock features.
These features help keep your financial data safer when your phone is shared or left unattended.
You can manage security options inside the app settings.
